gripOrHq.title: Imp
gripOrHq.rulesText: Imp can have up to 2 MU of programs installed in it. All icebreakers installed in this way have their strength reduced by 1. If IMP leaves play, trash all programs installed in it.

heapOrArchives.title: Broker
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Playful AI
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Roll a die. On a 1, 2, or 3, gain that many bits, set aside that many dice to roll again, or choose some combination thereof. Repeat until you have rolled all the dice you set aside.

rig.title: Self-Modifying Code
rig.rulesText: [T]: Search your stack for a program and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. Use this ability only during a run.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Smith's Pawnshop
rig.rulesText:
At the start of each of your turns, you may trash one of your other installed cards to gain [2].
Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

scoreArea.title: Fetal AI
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Fetal AI, do 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses Fetal AI from the Archives. If Fetal AI is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you. Runner must pay 2 to steal Fetal AI, in addition to any other costs.

scoreArea.title: Corporate War
scoreArea.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.

ice.title: Snowbank
ice.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Snowbank.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

root.title: Management Shake-Up
root.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: Systematic Layoffs
root.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.
